rows.en: Barkin: "Wh-What the hell?! It disappeared!"
Render: "Optical cloaking... So they've made it practical already...
All right, all units, stay sharp."
Resh: "Understood. Ryord, Kinari, don't push yourselves
too hard. You're not used to real combat yet."
Ryord: "Yes, sir."
Kinari: "Understood."
Render: (The information was accurate... But is that person
really... No, I should concentrate on the battle now.
They're here, too... Clovis Camillion,
Arthur Nkomo...)
Ai: "...Sorry, but I'm doing things my way this time."
Touya: "...What's wrong?"
Ai: "Well, it's nothing major.
Anyway, that's how it is."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but I'll be acting on my own
this time."
Touya: "Huh?"
Arthur: "There's something on my mind..."
Clovis: "Hey, Touya. I'll be going solo
this time. I'm counting on you to look after the other two."
Touya: "Hey, come on..."
Clovis: "Don't worry so much. You can handle it."
Clovis: "Hey. We meet again."
Render: "I'd wanted to face you in combat someday...
I didn't expect it to happen like this."
Clovis: "With skills like yours,
why are you helping terrorists?"
Render: "It's not terrorism. It's revolution.
I'd appreciate it if you didn't confuse the two.
Besides, you wouldn't understand even if I explained it,
and I have no intention of making you understand."
Clovis: "You're determined to fight, then?"
Render: "Yes. It's what I live for..."
Clovis: "What... do you mean by that?"
Render: "Enough talk.
Now, come at me!"
Arthur: "I'd prefer it if you withdrew."
Render: "I'm afraid I can't do that."
Arthur: "Are we really that much of an obstacle to you?"
Render: "That goes without saying. The Spirit Mechs are nothing
but obstacles to our ideals.
And you, personally, are an enemy I must defeat."
Arthur: "...Me? What do you mean?"
Render: "Look into your own heart!
Enough talk. Now, come at me!"
Touya: "I'm going to pay you back in full for last time!"
Render: "Heh..."
Touya: "What's so funny?!"
Render: "...Power makes people arrogant, doesn't it?
A machine's performance isn't all that decides a battle."
Touya: "Bullshit!"
Render: "Tch... To think you were this strong...
Have you grown even more powerful...?"
Clovis: "Hey, Arthur.
Do you know that Render guy?"
Arthur: "No. But what he said during that battle
has been bothering me, too.
He clearly said he was targeting me personally."
Clovis: "But the other day was the first time we'd fought him.
We haven't done anything for him to hold a grudge over..."
Arthur: "The only other possibility I can think of...
is that exercise..."
Clovis: "The exercise? The one where we ended up fighting Zigrim
in a skirmish?"
Arthur: "Yes."
Clovis: "It's true a nearby village
got caught up in the fighting..."
Arthur: "We were preoccupied with Melissa
being defeated at the time."
Clovis: "It's the only thing I can think of...
But we can't let ourselves be sacrificed to satisfy his grudge,
and I doubt that's what they want, either."
Arthur: "As long as he's targeting us,
we'll have to face him again whether we like it or not.
It isn't pleasant to have someone hate you, though."
Clovis: "Yeah. It may be the price of fighting,
but it still doesn't feel good."
Arthur: "Let's stop.
Until all the fighting is over, we should concentrate on being soldiers."
Clovis: "Yeah, I know.
Doubt on the battlefield can get you killed... Right."
Arthur: "Yes. Now, let's go to the bridge."
Miyasco: "It seems that machine from earlier knew
our exact position."
Derock: "With our optical cloaking,
it's a mystery how they knew where we were.
Someone must have leaked the information. I can't think of anything else."
Celica: "You're not going to say that person
is one of us, are you?"
Derock: "That's Lady Celica for you.
You always pick up on what I mean right away.
We practically finish each other's sentences."
Celica: "I don't want to understand what you're getting at,
but if that's how you think, Derock, I'll have you
leave this ship at the Holy Land."
Derock: "Ugh... Ha, ha ha ha...
O-Of course I was joking.
I-I'd never suspect my friends.
It was probably just a coincidence.
...No, definitely."
Celica: "...Anyway. Let's head for the Holy Land for now."
Ai: "...So, isn't it about time we chose a leader?"
Touya: "What do you mean, 'so'?"
Ai: "Oh, don't nitpick.
Besides, if we don't settle things like this properly,
they'll get complicated later."
Touya: "...Well, if you say so, I don't mind.
...So, who's going to do it? Clovis, maybe...?"
Clovis: "It's not my style.
Besides, that sort of tiresome business is Arthur's job."
Arthur: "Mine?"
Ai: "Oh, no, no. You're at your best as number two.
You're that sort of character, right? When someone like that becomes the leader,
they always die halfway through!"
Arthur: "O-Oh. Is that how it works...?"
Clovis: "Then who's right for the job?"
Ai: "Hmm... Leadership, character, piloting skill...
If you take all those things into account..."
Fain: "Me?"
Ai: "Ai's Puuunch!"
Fain: "Wh-What are you doing?!"
Ai: "You're obviously our charging-into-battle guy!
A leader should be, you know... coolheaded,
but with a burning spirit inside..."
Touya: "So who are you talking about?"
Ai: "Me! M-E!
Besides, you and I are the only ones left, aren't we?"
Fain: "..."
Ai: "Wh-What?! Have you got a problem with that?!"
Arthur: "Personally, I think Touya would be right for the job..."
Touya: "Huh?!"
Ai & Fain: "Whaaat?!"
Touya: "What?! You got a problem with me?!"
Ai: "If it's Touya, even Fain would be just as good."
Fain: "What do you mean, 'even'?! 'Even'?!"
Celica: "Hmm... Touya's improvement has certainly
been remarkable. As far as potential goes,
I don't think you could ask for more."
Ymir: "And Touya has been giving us orders
all this time. I think he's right for the job, too."
Ai: "Aah, even you, Ymir..."
Fain: "Th-That's right!
To think you'd say something like that, Ymir..."
Arthur: "Ai, Fain. A moment, please."
Ai: "What?"
Arthur: "Just come here a moment."
Fain: "What's the big deal? Why all the..."
Arthur: (whispering) "Being a leader isn't all good, you know.
If you only look at things like commanding a battle,
it may seem impressive,
but in practice you have to think up plans, give orders,
and deal with plenty of other tiresome things."
Touya: "Hey, what are you whispering about over there?"
Ai: "...Touya, good luck."
Fain: "Heh... I'll leave it to you."
Touya: "Hey, come on... Well, if you insist..."
Clovis: "That's settled, then."
Ymir: "Heh heh heh... Do your best, Touya."
???: "So it failed in the end... Queen Alforina is dead,
and we didn't get the crystal, either..."
????: "It seems working behind the scenes
backfired on us."
???: "Hmph! You failed because you used
a kid like that in the first place."
????: "But that child's ability
was worth using.
It's unfortunate that it ended in failure..."
???: "The 'Evil Eye'? That's nothing but a sham."
????: "Well, I suppose that depends on the person's heart.
More importantly, they seem to be heading for the Holy Land. Fortunately for us."
???: "Luck may be on our side,
but at this rate, who knows how long it'll take?
This time, I'm doing things my way."
????: "Wait. The person in charge of this is someone else.
I won't allow you to act on your own in their absence."
???: "I don't know who you think you are,
but I've waited three years, and the moment's finally almost here.
You think I'm going to let this chance slip away?!"
????: "That's not what I'm saying.
You're too obsessed with that.
That's why someone else is handling the direct action, isn't it?
We cannot afford to fail."
???: "Then where are they?
I'm the only one who can move freely right now.
Just watch. I'll do my job properly.
Or can't you decide anything without them?"
????: "...Very well.
If you insist, I'll leave it to you.
But don't go too far.
Killing them would defeat the whole purpose."
???: "Yeah, I know."
???: "Heh heh heh heh... At last..."
Bernst: "...Understood.
That person can be troublesome, but I'm sure it'll be fine.
Yes, I'll leave that matter to you. Goodbye."
Bernst: "Now, I suppose I should be going, too..."
